posts.author: SupaCLUCK
posts.desc:
Earlier this year, Chainlost reached out to me and asked if I wanted to build in a massive collab called The God of Dorabaebasic. Being someone who admires and frequently builds levels that resemble older styles in GD, I was naturally interested. I decided to go with the first part of segment 12/15, which uses Sourcream as the song and is based on 2.0. 
I replayed the dorabaebasic series prior to building to get some inspiration on how DORABAE built, such as his typical gameplay, structuring, design, and effect habits. You can probably tell that a lot of this was based on dorabae-basic12, but with my own touch to keep it original and modernize it for the collab. Even though it's a relat…...

posts.title: "QUARANTINE" by ciibule (Harder 7*) [3 Coins]
posts.author: Radar
posts.desc:
As an effect creator, this level really impressed me. I’m a big fan of all the wacky looking pulses and effects in “QUARANTINE”. I think for a level themed around this sort of computery/glitchy style Ciibule did a fantastic job. The blues and reds complement the white background very nicely. There’s a bunch of cool art pieces and area effects incorporated into a lot of the blocks as well to keep things super interesting and eye-catching. I’m not usually a fan of the use of inverted gradients, but for this style of level I think it works really nicely. 

My favorite segment is probably the wave at 0:20. Very cool block decoration with the blue blocks and error messages inside them. The masking in that segment is al…...

The ending especially moved me, and I had a small vision which I surprisingly managed to execute quite swiftly. it's probably my 2nd smallest level so far, though I believe one of my more artistic works and I am proud of what I've made. Give Requiem a listen, it's such an incredible album

posts.title: EPÍLOGO (September)
posts.author: Nezuu
posts.desc:
Este es probablemente el último video que suba a este canal.

Después de tantos años haciendo cosas en Geometry Dash, quise cerrar esta etapa de una forma que realmente tuviera sentido para mí. Este layout es una especie de epílogo, recorriendo y revisitando distintas etapas de todo lo que hice durante estos últimos 6 años, incluyendo cosas que probablemente ya ni recordaba.

Más que hacer un layout nuevo, quería mirar un poco hacia atrás. Ver cómo fui cambiando, las cosas que hice, las que dejé a medias, las que en su momento significaron mucho para mí y, sobre todo, recordar a toda la gente que estuvo ahí durante este camino.

A mis amigos, a la gente con la que hice collabs, a quienes jugaron mis niveles, a quienes me ayudaron, me inspiraron…...

Hello everyone! I know that many of you were not expecting me to release a new level today, so surprise!!! Surprisingly, this level actually has around the same amount of in-editor hours as my other level 'Touch the Orbs Bub." This style of level is actually so hard to make, and making this level made me gain a lot of respect for other levels that use default blocks in ways that feel uniquely like Geometry Dash. posts.author: sayonarofc
posts.desc:
tgc: https://t.me/sayonarofc


I can’t believe I actually finished this.

This level took 9 months to create, and those were probably some of the hardest months of my life. I went through all of it alongside this level, and I’m insanely happy that it’s finally over.

This level became my hardest mental challenge in the game. At one point, I just started to hate everything about it — my close friends can confirm that. I would rage at the game, tilt constantly, and sometimes I even felt like crying whenever I opened the editor.

I present to you my best solo — Steel Bloom n Rain.

A little about the level.

The entire level is packed with local references. There are tons of different graffiti pieces scattered throughout it, referencing my friends who supported me throughout this entire journey.

posts.title: С ДНЕМ РОЖДЕНИЯ!
posts.author: СТРАХ
posts.desc:
Честно, не думал что построю этот гп так быстро, залил его 17.06.26, а до др еще почти 2 месяца. Забавно, что из-за звездочек на бг в уровне 32к объектов, но это ваще не роляет. 
Поздравляю с твоим совершеннолетием Тимофей! Думаю к моменту выхода в свет этого шедеврального геймплея ты наконец-таки прошел свой новый хардест и выложил все экстримы которые прошел еще год назад (хотя в этом я очень сильно сомневаюсь). 
В прошлом году я планировал сделать геймплей на твой др, но что-то не сложилось, за это я очень сильно извиняюсь. Да я начинал его строить, но сил для завершения не хватило. Я думал насчет того, чтобы достроить его в этом году на твой день рождения, но все-таки решил сделать новый гп под новый сонг. 
Вообщем, я желаю тебе всего самого наилучшего и пройти слаутер! С днем рождения бебзена.

posts.author: Radar
posts.desc:
Creating with limitations can often lead to some incredibly memorable experiences. Made with entirely 2.0 restrictions, "Princess Demon" by BreadKing, is an outstanding entry for the Duality Gauntlet contest. There are so many original 2.0 levels that this level pays homage to, it’s packed full of nostalgia and creativity. Upon immediate viewing you can tell that this level calls back to a much more primitive time in the game's history, when creators and players often had to use their own imagination and suspend their disbelief to tell what was being shown within levels. It’s immediate to me that this level was made as a love letter to the game and levels within it, showing a deep appreciation for art made inside the editor.

Our hypothetical entry for the Duality Gauntlet, the theme was essentially 2 players, blending two dimensional planes in each section Blocks in 2D and background in 3D, or vice versa, and working with two colors.

Since we’re not kids anymore and live in a third-world country we didn’t have much time to fully focus on the project. Even so, we achieved a very satisfying result for just two months of work on the level.

The deadline and the object limit didn’t match the level of polish we wanted to achieve, so we decided to cancel the entry and finish things more carefully at our own pace.

posts.title: Mk2 by Dolphe (MY DUALITY ENTRY) | Geometry Dash
posts.author: Dolphe
posts.desc:
Mk2 by Dolphe
ID: 146198284

I hope you enjoy! 

This level takes place after Project Novaform where the player merges with Stubby, allowing Stubby to control the player to their will. Stubby's first task is to completely take down the city of Entrospire utilizing the player. 

This level was insanely rushed but I am glad to have gotten it out in time. Tbh I didn't really like it that much compared to my other projects, but I did still put a lot of love and effort into the project.

Originally there was going to be a prologue and epilogue but I sadly just ran out of time before I could get to either of those. The endscreen was haphazardly thrown together in an hour and ill probably replace it in the future.

Note: the level will be receiving a bunch of nerfs in the following days, as the consensus is that it is too hard for an easy demon....

@Viteral @meloni2662 @MaximalDash @dolb1nator @unifiedadept @MinAYGD

Акт 1: Мирная жизнь («Первый слой реальности»)
Утро начинается как обычно. Солнце встаёт над небольшим прибрежным городком, где люди занимаются своими делами: кто-то выгуливает собак, кто-то покупает кофе. На первом плане — группа студентов, обсуждающих планы на выходные. Никаких намёков на беду. Единственная странность — на небе видна едва заметная рябь, будто кто-то растягивает плёнку. Никто не обращает внимания.

Акт 2: Первые сигналы («Сбой в системе»)
Внезапно у всех горожан одновременно начинают звенеть телефоны. На экранах появляется одно и то же сообщение: «Мы идём. Не прячьтесь. Мы уже здесь». Отправитель неизвестен. Люди начинают паниковать. В небе появляются гигантские тени — сначала их принимают за облака, но они начинают опускаться. Это змеи. Огромные, сияю...

posts.title: [Duality Gauntlet Entry] PrintStream By NotKaizer | PaperSkies Knock2 - Dashtar | Geometry Dash 2.2
posts.author: ImNotKaizer
posts.desc:
When I first started this level, I was just making it for fun. I didn't have a release date in mind or even know when I'd finish it. As I kept working on it little by little, a friend was watching me build it and said, Why don't you make it for Duality? I replied, Nah, why would I? haha. Then he answered, Come on, it has that duality in the decoration. I thought about it and said, Alright, I'll give it a try.

That's how the idea of releasing it before Duality was born. My main goal was to create a music video-style level, combined with the Printstream aesthetic from Counter-Strike 2 skins. It also takes inspiration from the game itself in a few places.

This level was made purely for fun. I started building it about a year ago, and after grinding these last few days to finally finish it, it's ready. I really hope you enjoy how it turned ...

Huge thank you to @g.Ben. for recording the showcase and providing a thumbnail! 

I am finally participating in another Gauntlet contest! This idea, centered around the duality of destruction and life, came to me a couple of weeks after the contest was announced, but I was too demotivated to start a new project at the time. posts.title: Middle Window by erquillo1 | my DGC entry
posts.author: erquillo1
posts.desc:
I started this project in February under the name 'Thin Line'. Initially, it was intended to be one of several low-effort releases on my birthday (4 August), but I quickly became attached to the idea of entering it into the Duality Gauntlet Contest. With Middle Window, I have tried to portray real life and its regular ups and downs.

The level begins with a glass prism, which symbolises how something as dull as white light can transform into a captivating display of colour. In case it wasn't already clear, I tried to associate the monochromatic palette (black and white) with negative feelings, while the colours represent the joy and happiness that we always need. 

The second section features a substantial element: the Eye, which represents how others and you perceive yourself. We sometimes allow the thoughts of others and ourselves to in...

It was definitely one of the more accessible list demons and a favorite of people's due to the chill nature of it. This level is basically qoUEO but it's themed pretty differently, and uses ship instead of wave. You might not think it's top 10 because of how short it is, the how easy the second half is, but that ship part is borderline impossible, and something you'd find in a level nearing Aeternus in difficulty. posts.author: Viprin
posts.desc: SPIRALx3" is a level that AudieoVisual has been working on for several months now, and it's releasing today as of writing this. I typically try to avoid his streams despite how enjoyable they are, in which he mostly builds upcoming levels, so that I can see the full thing without any spoilers like now. It's always fun because he typically goes for an interesting theme that stands out from anything he's done before, while still being in his established style. For this one, the theming is early 2000s aesthetics, which is for example seen in the art in the foreground around 0:30. A part like this could easily be a bit weird to play with so much going on in the foreground, but the structures and obstacles stand out nicely in color, and the gameplay doesn't get too complex. I really like seeing all the little art and text that he made for thi...

hi!! i have a lot to say about this level, so i'd really appreciate if you read the description!

i will start with listing everything that is randomized in this level, because that's probably what most people care about:

As promised in the description of Elysium Mons Preview 2, a fun, quick side project that originally wasn’t in my scheduled line up.

I present to you the new and improved official version of Azure Flare! 

Had a lot of fun building this, took me about a month or so. I always liked this song and I was upset that it wasn’t used in anything more decent, and I always thought endlevel’s original version had lots of potential (Mainly because of the first wave), and endlevel had handed me the level, so I just decided why not. I wanted to push this level to its fullest potential while still feeling like a classic NC.

Hello again!

Long time no see! For those of you who may have thought you would never see an upload from me again, I was one of you for a while. This level is actually not new; it was finished in early December of 2025, but it took an absurdly long time to get effects finished, and then I honestly forgot the level existed for a while after it was basically finished, but now here it is! I am proud to present my first solo in (I think?) over a year!

This is one of those songs I always wanted to build to but could never find the motivation to. I love Camellia, but the conquest of building a minute+ layout to one of his songs seemed too daunting to even attempt. Then, one day, I was bored in my room and just said, "why not!" and started building. One idea led to another, creativity blossomed, and now you have this layout in front of you here...

This is a new solo by kyotosenkai. I'm pretty familiar with their levels and style, and from what I've seen before, I can say this is a big improvement. The decoration style is clean and unique—at the same time pretty classic, but still looking very fresh. I really like the approach to the style. The theme feels like something inspired by a console errors. I'm not a big fan of the fact that you can't skip the console animation in the middle of the level, but it's not a big deal (personally for me).

The gameplay might feel tricky at first because of some gimmicks like double blue pad walls and certain memory aspects. But after a few practice runs, it should be fun to play. Second solo from me! Nice!

After 1350+ hours into the editor, 25+ hours of constant fixes that was somewhat difficult, some funny moments between me and friends in private dms in discord, one fun of a ride is eventually over. And I present to you, Boundless Dreams. By me of course :)

My experience of building this level may or may not ever be experienced again in the future. When I originally started making this big of a project, I wasn't sure about how things were going really and how i'd plan out my ideas. At the time of 2024, in April/May, this idea surfaced on my head: Exploring the realm of dreams and it's boundaries of whatever possibility of anything. posts.author: Dolphe
posts.desc:
This is my entry for the Random Gauntlet Contest. This was quite the journey to make over the course of 5 months, and I poured so many hours into it that I legitimately cannot count. BetterEdit says 3497 (which is physically not possible), so my estimate was around 1000.

When there was around a little over a month left of the contest, Gostley reached out to me, offering to help build some of the Prologue. I was struggling to finish everything, so he crucially finished tons of stuff that I couldn't. Humongous thanks to Gostley for not only pouring basically 300 hours into the level, but also sacrificing his sleep and exams for this project. Please subscribe to his channel! @Gostley 

In terms of whether I'm proud of this project? Initially, I was kind of disappointed in it, left to think it was just a random gimmick level with mid bosses....

This level is a suggestion from Autodidactic Studio founded by Waterflame, pftq, Denny Schneidemesser, and used one of their K-pop songs by Waterflame PelleK and Blue.D.
I've been inactive lately, but I've been preparing for this level (also my life has been busy).

First, they gave me this K-pop song and asked that can you create GD level with this song?
So, I planned to create a Korean-style glow design.
Furthermore, with the popularity of K-pop Demon Hunters and the Korean Wave boom on social media, I thought now was the perfect time.
While I still have many shortcomings, I'm truly grateful for this opportunity and experience.
More than anything, I'm truly grateful for understanding and patience, even though I've been extremely busy

posts.title: Pale Machine's secret gameplay.. - Geometry Dash
posts.author: GenesisSuperNova
posts.desc:
I was having fun playing the new release of pale machine, a level hosted by Blueskii. I was looking around in the editor of the level, and I saw a completely different route very high in the editor. I searched a bit and messed around with a few triggers, and ended up toggling something. It allowed me to spawn up in that area and play this part of the level. What shocked me is how unbelievably fun this was as well. 
The song and note representation is top notch, and the gameplay flows so well. It's also super satisfying to play. Don't forget that this is secret gameplay hidden inside the original level!

I don't play omori, so I have no idea if this has any spoilers whatsoever.

posts.author: maxgreenevsky
posts.desc:
Второй парт, который был завершён за лето. Изначально его начинал чизкейк, но он словил дизмораль, поэтому достраивать пришлось мне. По сути, моя работа заключалась в оптимизации оригинальных дизайнов и их копипасте на всю длину парта.
В целом, я этим партом не очень доволен, и на то есть ряд причин, которые я раскрывать не стану.

posts.title: ⁉️COPYCAT by Vegtam (me) for @Audieo  Sampling CC #geometrydash
posts.author: Vegtam
posts.desc:
It's finished! It feels great to finally release this. While not one of my proudest works, I think it still does a lot of interesting stuff and will be very enjoyable to play. As you can see, I've gone for a more glowy/tech style, which fits the theme of AI and malware. Basically the plot is that you, the player, are a malicious software attempting to hack into Geometry Dash's fictional generative AI model, and stop it from scraping more creators' levels for training data. I believe I've adhered to my resolution to not take too much inspiration from other creators, which is ironic considering this is for a sampling CC. However, the core ideas and style choice are all original, and the samples are only there to strengthen the level concept. 

Hopefully this places higher than the level I made for Audieo's last cc, a stroll at midnight🙏. It

Hey everyone, I just wanted to share something I’ve been working on recently. I actually wrote a part for the song Kyoto by Phoebe Bridgers, which is one of my absolute favorites. The original already captures such a unique mix of raw honesty, melancholy, and energy, and I felt inspired to add my own touch to it. I tried to create a section that fits the emotional flow of the track while still reflecting my own perspective and style. Not long ago, we were advised to pick up this level for decoration because it’s reported to be fun to play, has a great feel to it, and is generally well-loved by the slayer community.

The structures, unfortunately, were a total nightmare — you can see them on the left. They were honestly hideous and completely impossible to decorate. On top of that, there were major camera issues that we also had to fix. Finally, the difficulty wasn't quite right; the level's potential clearly allowed for something much harder than Wasureta difficulty.

We managed to overhaul everything (including the structures, camera, and difficulty) in just 48 hours. 18/08/2024 - 30/08/2025

ESP

Bueno muchachos, la hora ha llegado. despues de un año en desarrollo, varias redecoraciones, procrastinacion y perfeccionismo al extremo les presento mi obra maestra, Scarlet Central. este nivel significa mucho para mi, y el poder ahora mostrarselos a ustedes me llena de felicidad.

Todo comenzo un 10 de agosto de 2024, cuando hubo una rate wave masiva de extreme demons de plataforma, y entre ellos se encontraba un nivel llamado Decaying Silo. Ese mismo dia me lo termine pasando y fue una de las mejores experiencias que tuve con este juego. ese nivel me hizo fanatico de los niveles speedrun al estilo de flood escape 2.

No seria sino hasta 8 dias despues que empezaria a hacer el layout de Scarlet Central, el cual nada mas me tomo 1 semana. la decoracion por otro lado... empecemos desde el principio.

posts.title: RARO
posts.author: Alkali
posts.desc: Really enjoyed this, a couple nitpicks but mostly an enjoyable level to play through and visually appealing too. The first part with the eyes and their pupils moving around, jittering looking around the space, really cool idea. Block design is fairly simple too, bringing attention to the background as it should. Particles add a subtle but effective detail to it too. The rest of the level follows on from it pretty well, the theming is fairly consistent (chaotic, flashy and sort of dystopian). I also enjoyed the gameplay, though for some parts it felt a little lackluster in terms of what it could have been, for example the ship part after about halfway didnt need any input, and some sections only needed a couple taps to pass. I dunno, I guess for a song like this I would have liked to see more input required, but again, a nitpick. Quite a c...

posts.title: Silent Circles [Sultar]
posts.author: Vernam LIVE
posts.desc: Сразу скажу: это геймплей с визуалами, не декор. Начнём с того, что парт получился очень динамичным и просто замечательно передаёт песню. И самое главное — как и во всех работах Султара, в нём прекрасно соблюдается играбельность. Я наблюдал, как этот парт строится в прямом эфире, буквально в реальном времени, и был просто в восторге от того, какое большое внимание Султар уделил тому, чтобы этот геймплей появлялся не просто из головы, из пустоты, а строился вокруг того, какие паттерны кликов буквально нативно просятся под этот сонг. Я не знаю, что будет с остальным геймплеем пока что, но в любом случае — приятного просмотра.

Glubfuberz is probably the most exciting "new" creator in 2.2 for me personally, and this level proves that once again. Once again it's themed around some creatures, with this one being about dinosaurs. The art for the dinosaurs is in Glubfuberz's recognizable clean and pleasant art style, which matches their backgrounds and block designs. However, due to the great color mixing and their animated appearance, they stand out nonetheless. The animations are of particular importance to me, since they make both this and their other works feel very alive and dynamic. I also like how Glubfuberz has kept up the alliteration in their level names. It's a small but cool touch that ties into their "branding" as a creator.

posts.title: Geometry Dash: Neural Network by me
posts.author: pocke
posts.desc:
Level ID: 124585007
Music: pearlbluesoul by nuphory

I made this level for GD Spirit Day, an event hosted by SirHadoken where a bunch of us made levels that were fun little levels that felt more like classic GD and released them all today on the game's anniversary (list id 860113). So, yes, this is a more chill level (if that's not to your tastes then maybe you should look out for my next level). I actually made about 50% of it on my phone, which I really had to get used to but it was kinda just a challenge I set for myself since I wanted to build on my phone more. I went for a mix of design and effects, and I was inspired to create this level by a college assignment I had where we had to make neural networks that played Tetris. I'm guessing people might compare this level to COPYCAT by vegtam, but I started this level before Audieo's cc

posts.title: 👑ANAMNESIS OFFICIAL PREQUEL | TECHNOGENESIS : How it Began | Gameplay Showcase
posts.author: Dolb1natoR
posts.desc:
Всё самое лучшее случается неожиданно. Готов представить вам полный геймплей своего самого крупного проекта в этой игре (на данный момент). 

Идея сделать приквел к уровню была у меня и моих знакомых еще после полного показа Анамнезиса, когда выяснилось, что в итоговом уровне тематика и сюжет до банальности простые, да и идеи удалось реализовать не все. Поэтому уровню нужна была предыстория, повествование о том, что произошло ДО того как появились руины в самом начале Anamnesis, и почему за нами на протяжении уровня ведётся охота какими то дронами? Все ответы будут скрываться в сюжете ЭТОГО уровня!

В этот раз я учёл почти все ошибки прошлого уровня, мы с гпшерами дали волю фантазии, и теперь в каждом парте есть свои разнообразные фишки, и почва для идей в декоре.

After 3 months of hard work, I’ve finally finished what might be my best level so far. I want to mention a few things, especially the parallax… yeah, it’s a bit of a mess, particularly around 0:32. I was planning on fixing it, but I ran out of time. And this is my first time experimenting with parallax on a level, so I know there’s a lot I can improve on next time.

Level was pretty rushed. I honestly didn’t think I’d finish it in time, but I locked in and did the best I could. 

Shoutout to my Playtesters you guys are awesome! wooo! and to my friends who kept encouraging me to keep going. I really appreciate it.

LDM will come soon after the results

Этот коллаб изначально строился для Вермира как подарок на день рождения (29.06), но спустя много месяцев заморозки команды, коллаб стал дополнительно ассоциироваться с ирл трудностями Вернама, а точнее весь его пережитый кошмар с 2022-го года. Насколько сложно иметь беззаботное желание и мотивацию хостить уровни в игре про кубики при крайне тяжёлых ирл обстоятельствах?

Как раз подходит образ пещеры - трудный путь в замкнутом пространстве, моральная подавленность из-за обстановки и отсутствие понимания когда это закончится, но не сдаёшься и продолжаешь идти дальше в надежде на лучшее будущее.

После переезда команды на основной дискорд сервер Вернама с бустиками, коллаб был разморожен, доделан и апдейтнут. Чувствую что результат можно сделать ещё лучше, но не хочу зацикливаться и лучше буду размораживать другие идейно-крутые коллабы.

posts.desc: This was another entry to the same event as "COGNITOHAZARD", which was showcased on the channel a couple months ago. However, this version is significantly nerfed, making me able to complete and record it myself. If you're unaware of that event, creators had to make megacollabs in a week, but if it was completed by another team, they were eliminated. As a result, both this and other entries were made as hard as possible. This one in particular used Geometry Dash's randomization for the section at 3:24, requiring you to either jump or not in each of 65 total loops, to create an "impossible" puzzle. However, some people were able to predict how the game's randomization works. posts.title: 🗣️my part in laminar flow (fishermen in disguise)
posts.author: illybwoy
posts.desc:
haha funny cheese part

this is part took longer to make than in roentgen realm, because of how technical jazz is and the intricacies of each note i had to represent. the theming was based on the new super mario bro ds sewer level (shoutout to autumn for noticing that), but in day 2 i realised that visuals dont really matter anymore so i toned down the visuals and underground theme. 

now, i honestly feel like the part should have been better executed, theres so many half baked gimmicks that couldve been expanded upon or made longer, like the gears that reduce the water level (shouldve been easier to miss collecting them), and ESPECIALLY THE CHEESE. if yall didnt know the whole cheese gimmick is that if you touch the cheese the mice instantly home in on you and kill you. i wanted the last wave section to be a whole cheese maze which you had to avoid, inspired by deltarune chapter 2. i didnt do it due to time constraints but i wish i did lmaoo. i also wanted to make the mice do more things, like they couldve easily been in every section of my part if i had time to plan out their mechanics. also if you couldnt tell its pretty rushed overall 💀. 

in the end i still think this is our team’s best entry ever thanks to my talented teammates. definitely our most impressive show of raw gameplay. go check the whole level out its on gyrodog’s channel

posts.author: qmystic
posts.desc:
so, i've been playing around with 2.2 triggers, and when i discovered that Event-Link trigger can activate inputs from Left/Right, i immediately had an idea to make a level that would not limit itself to just a single Jump button, which might be a super unusual concept for some players, playtesters has been reporting that "their brain has broke" lol

im not too sure about the deco theme yet, but i want it to be very clean and optimized, somewhat space-ish ig

also, about the difficulty:
I HAVE NO CLUE.
literally.
this is heavily dependent on the player's skillset and ability to adapt and comprehend multiple button presses at once, kind of like osu!mania. the gameplay itself is like insane demon, but it might end up somewhere in the list, considering the +3min length. we'll see. whatever, any (specific) placement in the demonlist is not my priority at all with this project, and i just wanted to make a fun and unique playing experience with this level, so i'll do heavy balancing and playtesting at multiple stages to ensure maximum playability. (if you think you can help with that, hmu)

posts.author: GamerKnight750
posts.desc:
Yeah, this is a public megacollab, and I believe it would be cool to join in a collab that uses this banger of a song. So I did. And here we are.

For the designs, I didn't want to spam glow or abuse shaders, so I tried to make smth that is as clean as possible. I think in the end, it looks neat imo. :)
If you wonder why the color scheme may remind you of flamewall, well yeah, the level's inspo has flamewall as part of the list of inspirations. I took my part in Flamewall as of inspo (not so much since it's SUPER outdated). While building the part, I thought it would be really cool to experiment some of the shader triggers in the editor to see where it can lead to. I also tried to keep effects as simple as possible for the sake of making sure the part doesn't go out of fit towards whatever the level's intention is aimed for.

posts.title: Layout - SERPENT by House Party
posts.author: Zeptoz
posts.desc:
Our second full layout has been completed, and I'm very proud with how this turned out. 
The layout is made with random gimmicks in mind; whatever type of gimmick you can think of, you make. This layout also uses the song trigger in some spots, which went in completely different parts of the song. This made for some very unorthodox gameplay, and I love working on this.

In terms of this getting decorated, I'm not sure if I will host it, but maybe someone else in our server can. I already have stuff I need to get done, and even if I were to wait a year to start it, I'm not sure what I will even be doing in a year, lol, so we will see.

Huge thanks to hsam for helping out with the VFX and fixes in general for the level. Please give him some love.  @hsam_ix 

Very proud of the team and enjoy the showcase.

posts.title: Freedom Dive by SrGuillester and more - [showcase] [fully decorated]
posts.author: Kolros716
posts.desc: After over 9 years since the first preview released on SrGuillester's channel back in November of 2016, one of the most legendary demons in Geometry Dash is finally decorated. No, it's not yet finished, because there is going to be an extension so that the level uses the whole song, which will be built by someone else, not me. This is the fully decorated version of Freedom Dive by SrGuillester, decorated by Azuler, Knobbelboy and Kolros (me). This is by far my best work yet in Geometry Dash in my opinion and this is easily my favorite level I've ever worked on. posts.desc:
Finally... after a lot of torture and suffering, here is my random gauntlet entry called Update Disorder! At first, I didnt really expect to make a random gauntlet entry because I didnt know what I would do for it. The theme/rules are much differebt than the space gauntlet where in that one we had a lot more freedom. Eventually, I got the Idea of "switching between updates" as a level theme which ended up to be my whole motivation to build this level. Even though It was a good concept, I still needed to build a whole level around it which was quite difficult. It was really demotivating to have almost no idea of what to do at every single part of the level or almost. That is why I asked some friends to help me go through the hell of the building process.

posts.desc:
This is another old work started way back in 2.1. I always liked listening to Clubstep; thus, I felt the need of creating a layout with it. Again, I occasionally come back to this and place a few blocks.

As you can see, it is a 1.9 gameplay with tons of fakes and confusing factors. I feel like 1.9 gameplay is inherently simple, you do not have many tools to create mechanically impressive layouts. Instead, I try to implement the fakes in 1.9 to actually blend the old memory levels and my current style (although not that current, this is quite old). posts.title: Spin Cycle by RadiationV2 (extreme demon - showcase)
posts.author: RadiationV2
posts.desc:
Surprise! Didnt expect to finish any new level in the near future, but I was told about DemonTime recently and had this undecoed gameplay sitting around. Decided the flow of the layout and its song were both too good to go to waste and wanted to try a more lax design approach again, like I did it back in 2.0 / early 2.1, with less thinking and more building. As such, I didnt plan overthink or redo most designs and I mostly stuck to what I'm used to or to simple ideas. I managed to deco this level in the span of two weeks over reasonably lengthed sittings somehow, which is extremely short compared to my usual works, which can take upwards of 8 months! 

The channel hitting 2k subs was also part of the motivation for this, so we can call it the 2k special as well. Hope you like it, and thanks for the support! :D

In my opinion, this is my best level, better than Kisaragi, NEO Sound, and my part in ORBIT.

I've been building this level almost every day for 11 months, starting around late July – early August of last year. It was initially supposed to be a random gauntlet entry, which explains why there are a bunch of random trigger mechanics scattered around the level, but I severely underestimated the amount of time this would eventually take. By the time of the deadline, I only had various parts half-finished, so I decided to try and make this my best level, which I believe I succeeded at in both gameplay and visuals.

posts.title: WRATH - GRAND FINAL SHOWCASE
posts.author: Inex
posts.desc:
Wrath by Inex and cherryteam

Хостинг уровня был действительно тяжёлым. На моих плечах буквально лежал проект, который могли осилить только я и Вернам — особенно селекция, где креаторам нужно было подняться, помочь на их становлении, а планка уровня буквально сжирала многих. Но anyway на 95% уровень состоит из наших пацанов, они просто сильнейшие.

Я считаю, что несмотря на некоторые моменты, уровень вышел шикарным. Даже селекция — всё равно потрясающе.
В уровень было вложено много души: мы старались как могли, продумывали образы, интро, энд-арт…

Со своей стороны скажу, что хостить его было адски трудно — не потому что креаторы не делали, а из-за обстоятельств. Это было слишком тяжело, но в итоге вы сейчас смотрите этот шоукейс.

Спасибо всем.

posts.title: [4K] MY RANDOM GAUNTLET ENTRY!!! “WSBMR” by Anya21 (Insane 9) |  Geometry Dash 2.2
posts.author: Anya21
posts.desc:
Normally, I don’t like participating in contests because I feel pressured when making levels. Right now, the time I have for GD is very limited due to university, but it happened that I was on vacation, and after seeing the contest announcement I couldn’t stop thinking of ideas for the level. So that same day I started working on the layout, and 40 days later I finished decorating it.

The dynamic of this level is that some parts of the gameplay change randomly. In some sections only the vehicle changes, in others an orb sends you onto a different path, and in some cases the entire section is completely random, which forces you to always be alert and ready to click. posts.title: Floraverse by Zoroa (me)
posts.author: Zoroa
posts.desc:
45K+ objects & 311 hours in over a year

[Read the pinned comment for the full length version of the description]

As of today, this is simultaneously my most ambitious and mentally breaking level to have made in my creating career. I don't think the hard part for why it took so long to finish was the actual building aspect of it, but it was really the consistently brutal struggles to get myself to build at all. I've definitely been getting more and more demotivated to build or even open the game as much anymore, but I guess that's what 11 years in the game will do to you.

[TW // Extreme depressive thoughts]
Demotivation & the unwillingness to do literally anything hit me the hardest it's ever affected me. I never felt so hopeless and disappointed with myself in making a level because it felt like an embarrassment to still be working on

posts.author: Motleyorc
posts.desc:
ID: 143517648

After ~3 years, this level is finally finished! I can't say much other than this project has gone through development hell for a very long time; it was basically a day 1 2.2 project, and was intended to be EXTREMELY long in scope (50+ rooms instead of 9...)

I built my room in very early 2.2, it's somewhat unimpressive (partially due to me not having touched the editor in years at that point), as well as some extremely tight object/group constraints.

I am extremely happy with how this level turned out, massive props to Fungifity and Subwoofer for their work on this. I wish I could have been more involved with the development of this level, but I am happy with my contributions (alongside with helping a lot with testing!).

A few months ago, Autodidactic Studios contacted me to check if we could get some levels made for some of their songs. This one in particular is a mashup of "Entering the Stronghold" by Danny Schneidemesser and "Field of Memories" by Waterflame, both songs that are from the old flash game Stick War. posts.title: 🆒"False Nostalgia" by kira9999 [All Coins] | Geometry Dash 2.2
posts.author: Viprin
posts.desc:
It's nice to see kira9999 releasing a very chill level after how crazy "Alien Dream Emulator" was. This is entirely slow speed without any flashy parts whatsoever. That does put more pressure on the details in the visuals and the overall atmosphere being interesting, which I'd say kira9999 succeeded with here. The entire level is very dark purple and a bit blurry, but the lantern the player holds reveals many neat patterns while mixing in some orange. There are still some light effects added on top, in the form of rain here, which is a natural choice to evoke nostalgia (given the level name). Around the borders, some black clouds get larger as you get further into the level, adding some progression. kira9999 does not change up the designs or decorations much in this, so the entire level feels like one free-flowing section. I can only guess that's why RobTop chose to give this a Featured rating, alongside the slow gameplay, but I personally could have seen this with an Epic rating.

posts.title: "Dead Angels" by MinAY | Geometry Dash 2.2
posts.author: Viprin
posts.desc:
Warning: This video contains rapidly flashing lights which may not be suitable for all audiences.

A few months ago, MinAY dropped "0 exit" which was his best solo level by far in my opinion, and it got a deserved Legendary rating. Now, he's back with "Dead Angels" which has some similarities in style. Notably, it's also pretty flashy with mostly blue and red for colors, as well as a lot of cool art. The theming is where it diverges, with this being more focused on angels, especially from the inspirations mentioned at the end, which also affects the block designs being more church-like. As a result, I think this stands out enough on its own. I mentioned the cool art already, but the effects, transitions, and general movement are also really nice, particularly during the drop sections. After House Party finished up the quicksilver layout we decided earlier this year to start decorating it and i'm very happy of how it's turning out so far. 
There really is no theme for the level just a traditional design and modern mixed level. We don't really have enough of these so I wanted to create one. It's fun and it gives the creative freedom for everyone to make what they want.
This level will be around low end extreme so it's more accessible to people. There are more incredible creators in the level that have yet to be shown to the public but just wait and see.

могу лишь сказать, что въебал в эту игру 2500 часов своей жизни всего за 1 год, не достигнув того, что я хотел... но вместо этого я получил нечто куда большее. я познакомился с огромным количеством ахуительных людей, с которыми я могу поговорить о всем, что хочу, которые поддержат меня в моих решениях и начинаниях. меня настолько затянуло это коммьюнити, что я, развиваясь, забывал о происходящем в реальной жизни бля))) при этом гд помогла мне понять и познать себя.

но несмотря на это, встречал множество прям отбитых дегенератов, выставлявших любых людей, кроме своих кентов на посмешище. не понимаю я их... но похуй, они все равно не могли перечеркнуть тех, кто помогал, когда было нужно, кто понимал т...

It's been a bit since I uploaded a level, but here I am with another, Snowsquall by me & Shyne. One of the only difficulties I've never dabbled in is insane demon, which is what we went for with this level. Huge thank you to Shyne for making the gameplay for the start and end (most of the level), I really love how it turned out and had a blast verifying this. 

The idea for this started from a GD Rivals level called "Shifting Temple" that Nau and Rayquandia worked on. I was originally going to finish that level but working with other people's editor is always a struggle for me, and I can never figure out where to start. posts.author: Detherrr
posts.desc:
EN: Initially, it was a test end screen for a friend's contest, which later became just an art, and then I decided to animate it. 
It didn't came out exactly as I had originally intended, but it's good maybe. I worked hard on the render and the initial animations, but the ending is a bit strange, as it was made out of laziness.
During the process, I tried some new objects at rendering; it was fun to build.
The house is intentionally a little crooked, because, it's surrealism and all.


RU: Изначально тестовый энд-скринчик для конкурса друга, который потом стал просто артом, а затем я решил это дело немного санимировать. 
Получилось не совсем то, что я задумывал изначально, но вроде прик. Над рендером и начальными анимками старался, концовка немного кринж, потому что немножко лень было.

posts.title: Opium (My Best Level)
posts.author: Atomic Rest
posts.desc:
Level ID: 143410071

I understand you probably weren’t expecting this from the same creator who made two of the silliest levels in GD history. I really enjoyed creating Opium, as it was so different from my typical style. I wanted to try something new, focusing on atmosphere, song representation, and symbolism.

I am blessed that substance abuse hasn’t played a significant role in my life, but friends around me that I see every day and care about are in a constant struggle. This level is a story about addiction, but from an outside point of view. Rather than being told from the perspective of the addict, it’s told from the perspective of a family member. I made this level to show how addiction doesn’t just affect oneself, but those around you, and those you love. If you or someone you know is suffering from addiction, this level...

posts.title: "The Pumpkin Lantern" - Upcoming TOP-1 extreme demon full layout // Hosted by me // Halloween demon
posts.author: SinisteR [PT]
posts.desc:
RUS:
    История этого уровня, как задумки, началась 6 с небольшим лет назад. В то время строчку топ-1 в демон листе занимал Зодиак, недавно проверенный на тот момент. posts.desc:
= LEVEL INFO =
Name: Scarlet Sirius
Difficulty: Extreme Demon (really hard)
ID: N/A

= DESCRIPTION =
If you don't know, Scarlet Sirius is the official crimson planet sequel started by TrueOmega and given to Bibox. Bibox asked me to build in this a while back, but I was a bit slow to respond. Today they reached out asking if I'd like to make some gameplay for this level. I banged this out in a couple hours, and I am decently proud of what I made. This may or may not be used as some of the collab members said it felt too derivative of Crimson Planet. Personally, I find it charming and cool to see sequels acknowledge their predecessors in a new and creative way.

Regardless I am still very happy with this and I'm glad I was given the opportunity to build.

posts.desc:
Huge thanks to  ⁨@fnm04   for recording this for me! Unfortunately my laptop is not able to run the level well, let alone record it. 

This is about 25% done in terms of total progress. The process has been a bit slower than I've wanted due to IRL circumstances, as well as a lack of streaming. It's easier for me to decorate when streaming, but because this level is hard on my computer, I can barely run it when on Twitch. 

The current object count is 44797. I know this is a high number (this is after 7k objects optimized as well.) I will try my best to get that number lower, but it's going to be difficult. In the past, my style hasn't been very object heavy. I think the reason the object count is so high is because I'm not used to this style of decoration yet. I do love trying new styles though, and I'm having fun making this level.
